observed.caption: A tall cylindrical tower with a disc-shaped roof stands beside a conical-roof building behind a fenced plaza under a clear sky.
observed.description: A tall cylindrical high-rise tower with horizontal window bands and a flat disc-shaped roof dominates the center-left against a clear pale blue sky, with a low wide building with a dark conical roof to its right, both sitting on a dark horizontal podium structure. In the foreground a light-tiled paved walkway leads to a black metal grid fence and gate enclosing a plaza, with a patch of green grass and a white spherical garden lamp on the right, a row of tall thin flagpoles in front of the podium, a statue on a pedestal near the fence on the right, and low shrubbery and flower beds along the inside of the fence.
